_comment: ngsolve hdivdiv#1 (a CLAMPED HHJ plate needs a dw/dn=0 term). Verified 2026-08-03 on NGSolve 6.2.2604, maxh=0.15 order=2, E=1 nu=0.3 t=1 q=1 (D=0.0915751). The boundary M_nn dofs of the HDivDiv space ARE the Lagrange multiplier for dw/dn=0; putting a homogeneous Dirichlet on M_nn deletes them, and the solve then returns the SIMPLY-SUPPORTED Navier value 4.437e-02 = 3.22x the Timoshenko clamped reference 0.00126 q L^4/D = 1.3759e-02 (inside the documented 3-4x band), with a boundary |dw/dn| that is 2.4x w_c/L. Retaining the multiplier gives 1.386e-02 (0.7% from the clamped reference) and cuts the boundary |dw/dn| by 7.4x. Boundary dw/dn is measured through BoundaryFromVolumeCF because Grad() inside a ds integral is the SURFACE gradient, whose normal component is identically zero. MUTATION CONTROL (re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 sets CLAMPED_KILLS_MULTIPLIER=False, so the wrong study no longer puts a homogeneous Dirichlet on the boundary M_nn dofs and the dw/dn Lagrange multiplier survives -- the documented fix applied at the pathology site. Re-verified by execution 2026-08-06 on NGSolve 6.2.2604: the unmutated run matches all 7 expect_in_output strings; T2_MUTATE=1 moves the 'no dw/dn' centre from 4.437e-02 to 1.386e-02 (1.0074x the clamped reference), so it removes 'no_dwdn_term_3x_to_4x_clamped=True', 'no_dwdn_term_is_simply_supported=True' and 'with_dwdn_term_reduces_bnd_dwdn=True' and makes the forbidden 'FAIL:' appear. Observed while running the control: 'no_dwdn_term_bnd_dwdn_unenforced=True' SURVIVES, because its absolute threshold 0.1 is cleared by the correctly clamped solution too (0.331 vs 2.432); only the relative check with_dwdn_term_reduces_bnd_dwdn separates enforced from unenforced.
